description: The owner-earnings growth a share price requires over 10 years (a reverse DCF) at 8, 9, 10 and 12% required returns, from the company's SEC filings, followed by the full owner-earnings valuation. The reading that does not depend on a chosen hurdle rate. Example questions: "What growth is priced into Nvidia?"; "What does the market expect from Costco at $900?"; "Reverse DCF on KO"

long_bond_pct.description: Long-bond yield in percent (5.4 = 5.4%). Default: the latest 30-year Treasury par yield, fetched from treasury.gov

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

name: growth_priced_into_stock
title: Growth Priced Into a Stock
